candidate.title: HiTS-RAP
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina schematic of HiTS-RAP (high-throughput sequencing–RNA affinity profiling), specifically its flowcell DNA sequencing → Klenow duplex regeneration → Tus–Ter/T7 transcription halt → fluorescent-protein binding and scanning architecture. The library encodes RNAs to be displayed and assayed for protein binding; the DNA is sequenced, whereas RNA is the binding substrate. The far-left DNA icon and expanded method name identify the assay, not an extra transformation. All seven depicted operation blocks belong to this single workflow; no alternatives or branches are shown. RBNS and RNA-MaP are mentioned only as similar methods in catalogue prose and are outside this schematic.
